text:
ash: thinking out loud — what do folks think about an "api medallion" pattern for internal endpoints: a thin REST/gateway at the edge (bronze) that does auth/quota/transcoding, and typed gRPC/protobuf lanes inside (silver/gold) for platform services? low-lift for external clients, typed contracts for internal teams.
maria: i like the ergonomics but worried about telemetry & routing complexity. adding another layer often hides 5xx/latency sources. how would tracing/metrics propagate through bronze -> silver?
jake: agree with maria. if we keep the gateway purely stateless and propagate a trace/span + routed model id it should be OK. need consistent headers: `x-rw-trace`, `x-route-id`, `x-tenant`.
samir: quota enforcement question — bronze handles tenant-level quotas, but what about per-model or per-route units that live in silver? double counting risk.
ash: good point. idea: bronze emits a debit event to quota service but marks the request with `x-debit-id` so silver can reconcile, not re-debit. bronze = request-level guard, silver = authoritative billing / qos.
jake: that reconciliation sounds fine. also think about browser clients — grpc-web vs fetch/REST. majority of external apps will prefer JSON. gateway should support `grpc-web` + `json transcoding` fallback.
tayler: from Console/rollouts POV we also want per-route traffic splits and quick canary toggles. can we surface bronze -> silver weight overrides in the UI? e.g. route-level weight and a `rollout-id` header.
maria: telemetry-wise we should instrument bronze to attach a stable request id and the `rollout-id` so traces can be grouped. sampling rules should apply consistently across both layers.
ash: sketch of proto->gateway mapping:

```yaml
# gateway route example
- path: /v1/predict
  method: POST
  upstream: models.predict.v1.PredictService.Predict
  transcoding: true
  canary_header: x-rollout-id
  quota_key: tenant_id
```

ash: this lets external clients call /v1/predict JSON, gateway transcodes to gRPC and forwards to the right model pool.
jake: tiny UX nit — error surface. gateway should translate common service errors back to HTTP-friendly codes and include a `x-internal-code` for debugging.
samir: agreed. also we need a way to tag which quota tier applied (bronze/leaky bucket vs silver/strict). include `x-quota-applied: bronze|silver` header.
tayler: Console needs those headers for the per-route debugging view. also want to show latencies broken down: bronze processing, network, silver processing. so bronze should report `x-timing-bronze-ms` and silver `x-timing-upstream-ms`.
maria: observability aside — how do we version schemas? proto-first internal, but we still need JSON schema for external callers. maybe generate JSON schema from proto annotations and store in catalog.
ajake: yep — auto-gen JSON schemas + examples. gateway can validate incoming JSON against generated schema before transcoding.
ash: proposal: run 2-week spike. implement minimal gateway transcoder + header propagation, add quota reconcile marker, and a Console panel prototype showing rollout toggles and split metrics. if latency bump < 5ms p50 we proceed.
maria: :thumbsup: can we scope the spike to one model team? maybe search/embedding pipeline — has simple contract.
samir: i'll pair with maria on quota reconcile design. can own the quota events + `x-debit-id` lifecycle.
jake: i'll stub the grpc-web/transcode path and error mapping. i can mock the proto -> json schema generator.
tayler: i'll mock the console UI and add a fake `rollout-id` control that toggles weights. want to see signal aggregation.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered for branch `medallion-spike` to `dev` (sha: 3f4c2d). check http://ci/internal/3f4c2d for logs.
ash: nice. i'll open a short RFC with link to the spike plan and proposed telemetry headers. thanks everyone — let's sync in 48h to unblock work items.
maria: sounds good. quick followup — include a short backward-compat plan for clients we can't migrate to JSON -> we'll keep direct gRPC gateways for internal clients.
jake: noted. will add `grpc-direct` route option.
samir: timeline: quota design doc by EOD Friday, i'll post here.
tayler: i'll add a Console prototype screenshot to the RFC thread.
ash: :rocket:
